sentences.text: No: for this individual, non-business, floating-rate term loan sanctioned on 2026-02-10, the current RBI rule says pre-payment charge is not permitted, so Schedule II row 3’s 3% pre-payment fee does not comply.
The copy states a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding is payable on pre-payment or foreclosure.
The applicable rule for all loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals with floating rates says an RE shall not levy pre-payment charges.
The 2025 directions that allowed pre-payment charges in other cases were superseded and are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
